'''Broadaxe Squadron''' was a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] allied with [[Zsinj]].

==History==
At some point in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the unit was stationed on the [[Reprisal (Dreadnaught-class)|''Reprisal'']], and along with a false [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]], sent to attack the ''[[Millennium Falsehood]]'' over [[Comkin V]]. The unit was engaged by elements of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Wraith Squadron]] and sustained heavy casualties. [[Gara Petothel|Lara Notsil]] was briefly assigned to Broadaxe Squadron for this battle and she used her [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to transmit a message to the ''Millennium Falsehood'' while she fired on it.

==Organization==
Like most squadrons of its time, Broadaxe Squadron had twelve members.

==Equipment==
Broadaxe Squadron was equipped with TIE interceptors.
